create_document.description: Add a new document to an index. Provide a Document ID to control the id (the action fails if that id already exists; use Update document to change an existing one), or leave it blank to let Elasticsearch generate one.
create_document.display_str_template: Create a document in the Elasticsearch index '{0}'.
create_document.name: create_document

parameters.description: Name of the index to add the document to (for example 'products'). Elasticsearch creates the index automatically if it does not exist yet.
parameters.name: index

parameters.description: The document to store, as field/value pairs (for example, name: 'Wireless Headphones', price: 79.99).
parameters.name: document

parameters.description: Optional unique id for the new document. When blank, Elasticsearch generates one and returns it.
parameters.name: document_id

index.description: Index the document was written to

delete_document.description: Delete a document from an index by its Document ID.
delete_document.display_str_template: Delete document '{1}' from the Elasticsearch index '{0}'.
delete_document.name: delete_document

parameters.description: The index the document lives in.
parameters.name: index

parameters.description: The document's unique id within the index.
parameters.name: document_id

index.description: Index the document was deleted from

get_document.description: Retrieve a single document from an index by its Document ID.
get_document.display_str_template: Get document '{1}' from the Elasticsearch index '{0}'.
get_document.name: get_document

parameters.description: The index the document lives in.
parameters.name: index

parameters.description: The document's unique id within the index.
parameters.name: document_id

update_document.description: Update a document by its Document ID. The fields you provide are merged into the stored document, leaving its other fields unchanged.
update_document.display_str_template: Update document '{1}' in the Elasticsearch index '{0}'.
update_document.name: update_document

parameters.description: Name of the index the document lives in (for example 'products'). With 'Create if missing' on, a new index is created automatically if it does not exist yet.
parameters.name: index

parameters.description: The document's unique id within the index.
parameters.name: document_id

parameters.description: The fields to add or change, as field/value pairs (for example, price: 69.99). Fields you omit are left as they are.
parameters.name: document

parameters.description: When on, a document that does not exist yet is created from these fields instead of failing.
parameters.name: upsert

result.description: Elasticsearch write result, e.g. 'updated' or 'noop' when the fields already matched

description: Create, read, update, and delete documents in your Elasticsearch indices.
